# 2 Baruch Chapter 77 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 77:4 — book of life

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "I-will-write in-the-book-of-life all-the-deeds-of-those-who-are-righteous" |
| LOGOS | "I will write in the book of life all the deeds of those who are righteous" |
| PNEUMA | "I will record in the book of life all the deeds of the righteous" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Write in the book of life' preserves the traditional apocalyptic image; 'record' (PNEUMA) is synonymous but 'write in' better captures the Syriac 'ekhthov b-kthab hayye'.

---

## 77:14 — the eagle as messenger

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "I-fastened-it-to-the-neck-of-an-eagle, and-I-sent-it-away" |
| LOGOS | "I fastened it to the neck of an eagle, and I sent it away" |
| PNEUMA | "tied it around an eagle's neck, and sent it off" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Fastened to the neck' is the more precise rendering of the Syriac; PNEUMA's 'tied around' introduces a slightly different physical action.

---

## 77:24 — Zion as mother

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "she-who-was-the-mother-of-you-all has-been-given-over-to-the-nations" |
| LOGOS | "she who was the mother of you all has been given over to the nations" |
| PNEUMA | "She who was the mother of all of you has been handed over to the nations" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Given over' (Syriac: ethmeser) is a covenantal term for delivery/surrender; 'handed over' (PNEUMA) is acceptable but LOGOS's 'given over' is more traditional.
